capabilities: Authenticate with Spotify via OAuth login
Search for songs, albums, and artists
Retrieve playlist, track, and album information
Get recommendations and user listening data
disambiguation: Not a music player or note embedder; it only injects the Spotify SDK and you must write the calling code yourself.
extras: Usage requires writing JavaScript code yourself; the README only shows one search example and links to the official Spotify TS API.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to authenticate with and query the Spotify API from notes or scripts.

relations.evidence: This plugin is an injector for the Spotify SDK.

requires.name: Spotify Client ID and Client Secret

summary: Developer tool that injects the Spotify Web API SDK into Obsidian so you can call Spotify from your own JavaScript code.
